responsibility: This file defines the H8/300 multiplication instruction patterns, including signed and unsigned byte/word widening multiplies, general HI/SI multiplies on H8SX, highpart multiply results, and MAC-oriented bridge instructions for multiplier-capable variants. It lowers mult RTL into mulxs, mulxu, muls, mulu/u, and mac-related sequences, handles nibble-immediate operands where supported, and provides the split and CC-clobbering forms that expose both ordinary product generation and accumulator-style multiply-accumulate opportunities.
